description: cosine_filter with a cut-off of 5 s at a TR of 3 s on 370 volumes: a cosine basis of 444 columns, wider than the series, whose lstsq (DGELSD) and svd (DGESDD, DBDSDC's lower-bidiagonal path) reach DLASDQ leaves with nearly equal diagonals and superdiagonals at DBDSQR's convergence tolerance (random-testing finding 54131: 1 to 4 ulps). Fixed: DBDSQR's TOLMUL is glibc's pow(2^-53, -0.125) = 2^6.625 correctly rounded (the constant was 5.8e-6 off).
